name: India
prevalence_note: MHA I4C (1930 / cybercrime.gov.in), CERT-In, RBI & TRAI 2025-2026: English and Hindi 'Digital Arrest' video-call extortion posing as CBI/Customs/FedEx, fake TRAI mobile disconnection robocalls, mistaken UPI transfer / 'UPI collect' PIN traps, and bank KYC APK scams dominate.
cross_border_note: Cross-border cyber-fraud syndicates (especially in Southeast Asia) and SIM-box gateways spoof +91 Indian numbers or call from foreign prefixes (+92, +855, +856) in Indian English and Hindi; DoT and I4C operate automated international spoofed-call blocking and National Cybercrime Helpline 1930.

scams.name: Fake CBI / Customs / FedEx Parcel 'Digital Arrest' Video-Call Scam
scams.name_en: English-language fake FedEx/DHL contraband parcel & CBI/ED 'digital arrest' video extortion
scams.signals_en: Caller in English poses as FedEx/DHL courier staff or Customs claiming a parcel booked with the victim's Aadhaar contains illegal drugs/passports, then switches to uniformed imposters on Skype/WhatsApp video staging a 'digital arrest' and demanding...
scams.legit_en: MHA and I4C confirm there is NO concept of 'digital arrest' in Indian law—CBI, ED, NCB, Customs, and police never interrogate citizens on video calls or ask for fund-verification transfers.
bait_tactics: Sorry sir, mobile data inside my ground-floor flat is very weak so video calls never connect—please mail the official summons to my address.
Hold on, I have never shipped an international courier in my life; let me walk over to the local cyber police station in person to verify.

scams.name: Fake TRAI / DoT Mobile Disconnection Robocall Scam
scams.name_en: Fake TRAI or Department of Telecommunications call threatening mobile number disconnection in two hours
scams.signals_en: IVR robocall or live caller claiming to be from TRAI or DoT warns that all mobile numbers linked to the recipient's Aadhaar will be disconnected within two hours for sending illegal texts, prompting key-press connection to fake Mumbai/Delhi cyber police.
scams.legit_en: TRAI officially states it never calls or messages consumers regarding mobile number disconnection—billing/KYC disconnections are handled solely by licensed telecom service providers.
bait_tactics: Wait please, I cannot hear the automated recording clearly because of street traffic—which telecom operator issued this alleged SIM?
Let me check my registered connections myself on the official Sanchar Saathi portal rather than pressing any keypad buttons.

scams.name: Mistaken UPI Transfer / 'UPI Collect' PIN & Bank KYC Scam
scams.name_en: Fake mistaken UPI transfer refund plea, 'UPI collect' request, or bank KYC remote-APK scam
scams.signals_en: Caller either sends a fake credit SMS claiming they mistakenly sent money for a medical emergency and pushes a 'UPI collect' request / QR code to 'receive/refund', or poses as a bank officer asking to install an APK/AnyDesk app for PAN/KYC update.
scams.legit_en: RBI Kehta Hai and CERT-In emphasize that a UPI PIN is ONLY needed to deduct money—never to receive money—and banks never send `.apk` files over WhatsApp for KYC.
bait_tactics: Hold on, let me open my actual bank passbook balance first because SMS messages can easily be typed by anyone.
Why would receiving or checking a refund ask me to enter my secret UPI PIN? Let me verify with my branch manager first.

scams.name: डिजिटल अरेस्ट / नकली सीबीआई व कस्टम पार्सल धमकी
scams.name_en: Hindi-language fake Indian CBI / customs digital arrest and parcel seizure scam
scams.signals_en: Impersonates CBI, police, narcotics or customs in Hindi claiming an illegal parcel in the victim's name; threatens 'digital arrest' over video call and demands bail/verification transfer.
scams.legit_en: Indian law enforcement never conducts video-call digital arrests or asks for bail/verification money transfers over a call.
bait_tactics: बोलें कि फोन का नेटवर्क बहुत कमजोर है और आवाज कट रही है, धीरे से दोबारा पूरी बात समझाइए
कहें कि चश्मा दूसरे कमरे में रखा है और कागज-कलम ढूंढकर सब नोट करना है

scams.name: बैंक केवाईसी अपडेट व एनीडेस्क / ओटीपी ठगी
scams.name_en: Hindi bank KYC block threat demanding OTP or remote APK install
scams.signals_en: Claims bank account, electricity, or SIM will be blocked tonight unless KYC/PAN is updated via a WhatsApp APK link, AnyDesk, or spoken OTP.
scams.legit_en: Genuine Indian banks conduct KYC updates in-branch or via official portals without requesting OTPs or WhatsApp APKs.
bait_tactics: बोलें कि फोन हैंग हो गया है और स्क्रीन खुलने में बहुत समय लग रहा है
कहें कि पासबुक अलमारी में बंद है और कल सुबह बैंक शाखा जाकर खुद फॉर्म जमा करेंगे
